name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted AI engine with an OpenAI and Anthropic compatible API and a web UI for chat, image, speech and video models, running on CPU.

alerts.message: The first account registered in the web UI becomes the administrator. Register it right after deployment; later sign-ups wait for admin approval.
No model is preinstalled. Install one from the model library in the web UI; models run on CPU and need enough RAM and disk for their size.
